notes.title: Arcana Outcasts: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Thanks for the feedback on this project! I've been able to release an update to fix several important issues that were identified.

Reworked unstable shards to be more intuitive: you no longer need to wait until the previous phase ends before starting a new one, allowing a shard to be stabilized quicker at greater risk. Additionally improved telegraphing of phases to hopefully make the system more clear.
Added buttons to quickly switch between shard skill trees.
Added an option to disable crosshair.
Fixed hub world music ignoring the music volume setting.
Fixed a bug with switching shards not updating the mana UI properly.
Various minor graphical improvements.
